scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate design choices (Tol colorblind-safe palette, marginal box plot, percentile reference lines, leader-line callouts) lift this above generic, but the subtitle text overlaps the P25/P50 percentile labels and the 'Sam Q.' callout is truncated at the right edge — concrete layout bugs that cap the score.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest — log scale is appropriate for right-skewed income, dot radius is fixed (no lie factor), box plot statistics and percentile lines are data-driven via d3.quantile; only weakness is the hardcoded xScale domain [14000, 550000] rather than d3.extent(data, d => d.income), which breaks the scaling and shift metamorphic relations.
scores.stress_test_note: Simulation is fully pre-computed offline (.stop() + manual ticks), only interactions are lightweight pointer-event tooltips with no brush/zoom/transitions, eliminating all five stress-test failure modes.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single conceptual view with a well-managed 4-color palette, pre-computed (non-animating) swarm, and a reinforcing marginal box plot keep load low — the only friction is five leader-line callouts compressed into the upper-right corner where curves cross and 10px labels crowd each other.

proposer: 241 → 236 lines. Removed single-use variables (`xAxis`, `innerWidth`, `boxH`) and unused `id` field, inlining their values at point of use.
